record.name: 灌林追踪者
record.text: 突袭 你每将牌洗入你的牌库一次，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。
record.text_en: [x]Rush Costs (1) less for each time you've shuffled cards into your deck.

policies.count: One successful semantic shuffle operation, not one per physical card. Named batch producers retain their original actor and owner; unknown direct insertion actor is an explicit unsupported price operand, never assumed zero.
policies.history: Record first actual insertion as the immutable operation witness, and bind all member insertion publications to it. Synchronous primitive delegation finishes before ordinary choice/reaction processing; no second scheduler or saved unfinished batch.
policies.eligibility: Actor must equal quoted player and recipient deck owner. Positional top/bottom moves, unchanged-deck shuffles, opening deal/mulligan and Prepare are not random insertion instances.
policies.timing: One credit at the first successful insertion publication; exact CN batch/reaction, opening-card and temporary-return policies remain uncalibrated.
